effects.actual_behavior: While self irradiated, tick requests heal1F every10 entity ticks with no explicit side gate. Absorb cooldown initializes/resets300+rand300 and decrements positive values. After expiry and without a stored target, server prefers irradiated owner within20; otherwise searches living bbox.inflate(9), excludes Raycat, requires Irradiated and (tame or not Player), picks nearest and stores ID/-1; resets cooldown even with none. No allied/team test. Stored target branch starts absorbAmount1, then decrements .05F; at <=0 self requests heal10F BEFORE requesting Irradiated200 ticks at (current self amplifier+1, else0). Looks at original target30/30; if living target still has Irradiated, preserves its remaining duration, removes exact effect, and if amplifier>0 adds duration/amplifier-1. Native add/remove returns are ignored. No explicit side gate around fulfillment and no distance/status revalidation before self heal; status is only rechecked before target removal. Shipped RESISTS_RADIATION tag includes raycat, so locked radiation-heal cancellation exemption applies by default; event outcome is not guaranteed. Command0/1/2 and native owner gate retain sit/follow behavior. Native OcelotAttack/Leap(.3F) goals with base attack1 are registered but no own target selector is invented.

effects.actual_behavior: Four independently instantiated WaterAnimal families share the same dry-out request shape: alive outside the species liquid predicate decrement previous air by1; only equality -20 resets air0 and requests native dryOut damage2F. Request return is discarded. Lanternfish resets air200, Radgill500, SeaPig40 and SweetishFish400 in liquid. Radgill liquid includes Acid fluid; SweetishFish includes Purple Soda; others use native water/bubble. SeaPig initial air40; bucket loads Lanternfish/Radgill/SeaPig2000 and SweetishFish400. No attacking/owner actor is synthesized. Radgill parent fall damage result subtracts5; SweetishFish rejects HUNGER in addition to the parent effect gate. No custom attack goal is registered for these four; Radgill HurtByTarget target state is not a damaging goal.

effects.actual_behavior: doHurtTarget first writes ATTACK_TICK5 and immediately delegates parent melee, returning that result. Independent tick later decrements positive attack clock and raises biteProgress up to5; when clock is no longer positive and biteProgress>4, a non-null target within1.3 gets a second native mobAttack(self) request equal to current float ATTACK_DAMAGE. That delayed request has no explicit side/alive/allied test and ignores its return. MeleeGoal only starts for a live target and duration<300; tick increments duration, navigates1 while target is in water/bubble, requests doHurtTarget below1.2 when cooldown0, sets30 then decrements during that tick. stop resets duration/cooldown, last hurt mob and target. Do not deduplicate the two native attempts. Own air callback is empty; baseTick restores saved air after parent only when in water, not an invented universal immunity.

effects.actual_behavior: Native IN_WALL immunity is ORed with parent admission. hurt delegates parent first and only a true return captures current hurtPos and fleeFor40+random.nextInt(40). tick decrements flee and clears position at0. AvoidHurtGoal requires position and timer, start exits standing, then uses getPosAway(16,7,hurtPos center) and navigation speed1.6F when missing/near retreat target (distanceSquared<6). Standing refreshes dimensions to scaled .95F x1.5F and navigation switching counter400+rand400; exit adds old height*.35F before dimension refresh. Standing tick stops navigation; airborne velocity adds -.05Y and multiplies(.5,1,.5). Ordinary self travel captures old velocity, transiently adds -.005Y when targetless/non-standing but moves and finally rescales the previously captured vector (.3F standing/.9 otherwise), so that transient term must not be reported as surviving the final write.
